correctness.rationale: The gradient uses allowed cofactors. At rank n-1 adjugate has rank one; a Cartesian support rectangle contained in the forbidden matching forces one forbidden diagonal singleton, equivalently entire corresponding row and column zero. At rank<=n-2 all cofactors vanish. Factorization A=UV^T with r=n-2 gives k disjoint irreducible bilinear equations U_i dot V_i=0 and irreducible rank-r image of affine dimension n^2-k-4, after GL_r quotient, yielding codim 3 in X. Explicit allowed partial permutation with unused row 1,2 and columns 3,4 verifies transverse 2x2 Schur parameters and degree remains standard corank2 determinantal degree. At zero row/column loci Schur complement gives nondegenerate sum u_jv_j. Jacobian codim excludes reducibility and ensures normality by R1/S2. Independent exhaustive GF2 checks n=4 k=2 examined 16384 matrices, 2632 singular (144 corank-one extra H_i), k=4 examined 4096, 826 singular (56 extra H_i), agreeing precisely. Finite checks not the universal proof.

final_claim: For char-0 algebraically closed fields, n>=4, 1<=k<=n, determinant on n by n matrices with diagonal matching a_11=...=a_kk=0 has exactly k+1 reduced singular components: an irreducible corank-two locus of codim 3 in the hypersurface and degree n^2(n^2-1)/12, plus k zero-row-and-column linear spaces codim 2n-3; transverse quadrics are uv-wz and sum_(j=1)^(n-1) u_jv_j, respectively, and hypersurface is integral normal CM Gorenstein.
